ios.desc:
Find something good to cook, make the recipe yours, and keep the next meal within reach.

DISCOVER AND SAVE
Search 2,881 community recipes and 32 Simplies originals by dish or ingredient. Filter by cooking time, browse in a dark, easy-to-read interface, and save favorites to your on-device cookbook.

BRING YOUR OWN RECIPES
Add a recipe from a public recipe webpage, scan a printed recipe with a photo, or enter it yourself. Review and edit the imported details before saving. Scanned text can need correction, so check it against the original.

PLAN AND SHOP
Plan a recipe for a day, generate meals for open days, and add planned ingredients to your grocery list. Adjust servings and meals to scale ingredient quantities. Tap supported measurements to see compatible unit choices. Check off items as you shop.

COOK ONE STEP AT A TIME
Follow recipe instructions, track your place, and set named cooking timers. Live Activities are available on supported devices and settings. Timers and alerts follow your device’s notification and system settings.

READY OFFLINE
Connect once to download the reviewed community catalog. After it is stored on your device, you can browse and search it offline. Your saved recipes, plans, and grocery list stay on this device. No account or subscription is required.

Recipe text from Wikibooks contributors is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0, with source and license details in the app. Simplies originals were drafted with AI assistance. Recipes have not been independently kitchen-tested by Simplies; cooking times are estimates. Serving illustrations are AI-generated artwork, not photographs of finished dishes.
